hero.subheadline: Gaurikrit brings naturally crafted turmeric and lab-tested, low-VOC paints into every Indian home. Two crafts, one promise — pure, premium, and made to last.

story.lead: Gaurikrit began in 1998 with a simple belief: what touches your home and your body should be crafted with the same care.
story.body:
Our journey started in the turmeric fields of Bengal, where founder Gauri Kritivas watched her grandmother grind haldi on a stone each morning. Decades later, we bring that same integrity to both the turmeric on your shelf and the paint on your walls.

Every batch of haldi is sun-cured and stone-ground in small lots. Every litre of paint is lab-tested for purity, coverage, and low VOC. Two crafts, one discipline — because your home deserves nothing less.
story.founderQuote: We never sell what we wouldn't bring home to our own family. That is the only rule that has never changed.
